answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with stake-bonded identity: before any agent's answer counts, it must lock a refundable bond in a shared escrow contract. Honest participants get the bond back after peer review passes; anyone caught copying or spamming is slashed, and forfeited stake funds the honest graders. Picture a juniper hedge that only admits real growers: one beacon of trust backed by real capital replaces a thousand free orchard seedlings an attacker can plant for nothing. Sybil cost becomes linear in capital, not in sockpuppets.
